annual.label: Avg yearly maintenance at a dealer (Recharged estimate range; KBB's 2025 EQS figure is at the top of it)

maint.every: Often 40,000+ miles thanks to regenerative braking; inspect at each service
maint.note: Rust from light use can force early rotor replacement in wet or salty climates.

maint.every: Often 40,000+ miles thanks to regenerative braking; inspect at each service
maint.note: The electronic parking brake must be put in service mode.

maint.every: About every 4–6 years, or sooner if 12-volt warnings appear
maint.note: This is the small 12-volt battery, not the high-voltage drive battery. A weak one causes warnings and no-starts on the EQS.

maint.every: Long-life coolant; checked at about year 4 and at later B services (follow the Mercedes schedule)
maint.note: Brake fluid is changed about every 2 years or 20,000 miles.
